drafts.angle: Personal eval, applied to ads (rides @rauchg 'personal eval… It picked Neon', 133K, plus @OfficialLoganK's Gemini Neon/API posts, 103K and 93K)
drafts.draft_en:
Builders now run a personal eval before they pick a coding model.

Almost nobody runs one before they let a model write their ads.

Same idea, different test set:

- your brand rules
- your legal claims
- each ad platform's policy

Score every AI-made ad against them before it ships. Approve, fix, or block.
drafts.video_tip: 40s screen recording: split screen of two AI-generated ad variants, run both through the check, show one approved and one blocked with the one-line reason. Voiceover reads the first two lines. Captions burned in, native upload, link in the first reply, not the post.

drafts.angle: Ultra-short one-liner (rides @sama 'Jensen!' 3.13M and 'This is really really good' 644K, plus @AlexHormozi's one-liners, 149K / 99K)
drafts.draft_en: The most expensive ad is the one nobody checked before it went live.
drafts.video_tip: Text-only is the play for this pattern. If you add video: a 7s selfie clip saying the line straight to camera, line as a caption from frame 1, then reply to the best quote-posts.

drafts.angle: Numbered 'things are insane right now' list (rides @gregisenberg's 5-item list, 117K with 2.6K bookmarks, and @levie's agent-swarm and services-scale posts, 100K / 60K, ~1-2x bookmarks to likes)
drafts.draft_en:
Things are insane in AI ads right now:

1. one prompt makes hundreds of ad variants
2. agents can launch and test them without a human in the loop
3. platforms keep tightening AI and claims policies
4. brand teams didn't grow to match
5. the review step is still a person with a spreadsheet

Generating creative scales. Checking it has to scale too.
drafts.video_tip: 30s talking head with each numbered line popping on screen as you say it; hold #5 for 2s, then cut to an approve/fix/block end card. No music, captions burned in.
